parent.title: A weekend in Brusaporto, anchored on Da Vittorio

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: Seven boutique, historic and agriturismo stays within an 8–12 km taxi ride of Da Vittorio in Brusaporto, ranked by character, price and post-dinner logistics.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: A 30-km radius from Da Vittorio (Brusaporto) covers Bergamo Città Alta, the Franciacorta cellars, Lake Iseo and Monte Isola, the UNESCO Crespi d'Adda model village and easy Prealp hikes — enough for two full days around a Saturday-night dinner.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: Calendar of IT, AI, robotics and Industry 4.0 events inside the Bergamo basin — within 30 km of Brusaporto.

sources.title: davittorio.com — La Dimora
sources.claim: La Dimora is Da Vittorio's on-site 10-room Relais & Châteaux hotel; Junior Suite €700, Double €650, breakfast included.

sources.title: davittorio.com — Cantalupa estate
sources.claim: 10-hectare estate, two lakes, 800 m strolling circuit, tennis court, ~10 min by car from Bergamo.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Da Vittorio hotel
sources.claim: 4.7/5, 195 reviews, #1 of 2 hotels in Brusaporto; standard rooms $690–$943/night.

sources.title: Relais & Châteaux — Da Vittorio hotel
sources.claim: Member: 3-star restaurant and 10-room luxury hotel.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Da Vittorio
sources.claim: Three stars in the 2026 Michelin Guide Italia.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Hotels near Da Vittorio
sources.claim: Next-nearest hotel cohort starts 3.7 mi out (Winter Garden Grassobbio, NH Orio al Serio, Radisson Blu ChorusLife).

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Joia Hotel & Luxury Apartments
sources.claim: 4.1/5, 196 reviews; standard room $153–$221; described as 'in the middle of a field'; 28 steps from parking to room.

sources.title: Booking.com — Joia Hotel & Luxury Apartments
sources.claim: 30 rooms with kitchenettes, outdoor pool, breakfast buffet; 8.4 'Very Good' (693 reviews).

sources.title: joiahotel.it
sources.claim: Via Cascina La Cà SNC, 24060 Brusaporto; pool, free WiFi, 24-hour reception; pets allowed.

sources.title: italia.it — Joia Hotel listing
sources.claim: Da Vittorio is approximately a 19-minute walk from the hotel.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — La Vacherie
sources.claim: Restored 1800s farmhouse restaurant 0.09 km from Joia; 1.37 km from Da Vittorio.

sources.title: brusaretro.it — Pernottare
sources.claim: Local guide: only Da Vittorio and Joia inside the village; nearest agriturismo (Sant'Alessandro, 4 rooms) is in Albano S. Alessandro 2 km south.

sources.title: Booking.com — Hotel Excelsior San Marco
sources.claim: Piazza della Repubblica, Bergamo Bassa; 2-min walk to Città Alta funicular; 8.5/10; rooftop restaurant.

sources.title: gombithotel.com
sources.claim: 12 rooms + 3 suites inside the Venetian walls of Città Alta, next to the 13th-c. Torre del Gombito; Booking.com 9.8.

sources.title: corteseguini.it
sources.claim: 1600s building in Bagnatica, 5-min walk to centre; $155–$179; Booking.com 9.6.

sources.title: Relais & Châteaux — Da Vittorio restaurant
sources.claim: Restaurant and 10-room hotel run by the Cerea family, ever-present in kitchen and dining room.

sources.title: davittorio.com — Contact
sources.claim: Private helicopter arrivals to the estate via partner Air-Dynamic.

sources.title: bergamo-airport.com — Taxi
sources.claim: Taxi from Orio al Serio (BGY) to Brusaporto: €20–€35 one-way for the ~10 km hop.

sources.title: Kayak — Joia Hotel & Luxury Apartments
sources.claim: Joia Hotel listed from $86/night on Kayak.

sources.title: laviadellesorelle.it — A casa di Lalla
sources.claim: Pilgrim-route donation B&B, Via Monte Alben 11 — 2 bunk beds, strict 18:00–08:00 check-in window.
